summary: ZoomInfo Technologies Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Credit Agreement Amendment increasing its revolving credit commitments by $26 million to $276 million. The amendment involves ZoomInfo LLC as borrower with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc. as administrative agent, under the same terms as the existing facility. The filing also includes a press release for Q1 2026 earnings. This is a routine financing arrangement and earnings disclosure, not a special situation transaction or event-driven catalyst.
